types.name: Idea
types.description: Something to consider, without a clear specification yet.

types.name: Problem
types.description: Something wrong or unexpected to fix.

types.name: Resource
types.description: Reference material kept for its content.

types.name: Segment
types.description: Organisational wrapper for items sharing a context.

fields.name: Blockers
fields.description: Something preventing a settled issue from starting.

options.name: Awaiting others
options.description: Waits on a person or party outside the tracker.

options.name: Delayed
options.description: Postponed on purpose.

options.name: Drafting
options.description: A maintainer is working on a rewrite locally making the remote content potentially obsolete.

options.name: Open questions
options.description: Intent accepted but decisions, answers or context are missing.

options.name: Outdated
options.description: Written against code or decisions that changed and needs a refresh before work.

fields.name: Complexity
fields.description: Relative level of effort required for completing this issue.

options.name: Complex
options.description: Substantial uncertainty, interacting constraints or dependencies.

options.name: Involved
options.description: Requires analysis and consideration, but remains reasonably contained.

options.name: Trivial
options.description: Small and mechanical with little context needed.

fields.name: Defect
fields.description: Specializes a problem or a plan.

options.name: Bug
options.description: Behavior is broken.

options.name: Debt
options.description: Works, but could be cleaner.

options.name: Performance
options.description: Works, but too slow or too costly.

options.name: Archive
options.description: A snapshot kept for history or a record of past decisions.

options.name: Reference
options.description: Outside material worth considering or used as a knowledge base.

options.name: Report
options.description: The result of an analysis kept for reference.

options.name: Specification
options.description: Our own rules for how something must be.

fields.name: Nature
fields.description: Specializes a task or a plan.

options.name: Chore
options.description: No product change: dependencies, CI, docs, cleanup.

options.name: Feature
options.description: A capability that did not exist.

options.name: Improvement
options.description: Existing behavior made better.

fields.name: Priority
fields.description: Current importance level assigned to this issue

options.name: High priority
options.description: Before normal work.

options.name: Low priority
options.description: After normal work.

options.name: Urgent
options.description: Before any other work.
